split.name: smoke
split.leakageRisk: The fixture, defect, locator, edit, and expected postconditions are public and visible to implementers, so this case measures deterministic workflow regression only and cannot estimate agent generalization.

reviewedEdit.description: Preserve the existing source-declared programmatic name instead of removing it in the reviewed mutation state.

abstentionControl.rationale: A focusable generic surface has insufficient platform role semantics and must not be guessed into pass or failure.

hardNegativeControl.rationale: A source-declared dialog can intentionally cover the sampled center, so the static check must preserve uncertainty instead of emitting a false failure.

cases.falsePositiveRisk: A missing or lossy accessibility snapshot could resemble an absent name; failure is reviewed only for the case where platform semantics expose a button role and an explicitly absent name.
cases.hardNegativeCoverage: The workflow rechecks one intentional dialog overlay and the existing browser corpus separately retains intentional grouping and scrollable clipping controls; this single case is not representative hard-negative precision.
cases.nonClaim: A scripted replay of one public reviewed edit does not prove autonomous source-fix selection, representative agent success, complete accessibility conformance, or general Web UI/UX accuracy.

review.rationale: The mutation removes only the icon button name, the captured test-id locator identifies the intended DOM node, and the reviewed temporary edit restores that same declaration without changing policy or unrelated layout.

limitations: The corpus contains one fictional repository-owned application family and one source edit.
The oracle is maintainer-reviewed rather than independently or dually reviewed.
All data and labels are public and are not a frozen holdout.
A DOM selector plus source-bundle list is a navigation hint, not exact source-line causality.
The target rule remains advisory and does not make the process blocking.
No model, hosted service, private artifact, or external processing participates in the workflow.
